name: aurora-unusual-throughput
title: An Aurora instance is transferring an unusual amount of data
description: Aurora read or network transmit throughput has remained above its expected range and minimum threshold for at least ten minutes while no recognised database activity job is running. This could indicate someone is copying or exfiltrating data.
investigation_steps: Open the alarm and compare read and network transmit throughput with recent normal activity.
Check database connections, application activity and Performance Insights for the same period.
Confirm whether the activity is expected and escalate immediately if possible data exfiltration cannot be ruled out.
Check for cron-tasks or scheduled jobs that could explain the unusual throughput.
If you find evidence that data exfiltration is occurring, escalate immediately and conisder turning off the service if there is reasonable suspicion of ongoing data exfiltration.
